::: {.brand-statement}
Future construction manager with an analyst's toolkit: I want to be on site, working with people and watching real projects come together, and I bring data to every decision along the way.
:::

## About Me

I'm a Business Information & Analytics student at the University of Denver's Daniels College of Business, continuing into DU's **M.S. in Real Estate and the Built Environment** through the 4+1 program, with a concentration in **construction management**.

I'm drawn to the field because I want to work with people and watch a real project come together, from the first day on site to the finished building. My plan is to start my career as a project and construction manager, learn how buildings actually get built, and after a few years bring that field experience back into the office.

Along the way, I lean on data. Excel, Python, SQL, and R help me analyze projects and make decisions I can back up.

## What I'm Looking For

A **summer 2027 internship with a general contractor**, ideally in residential construction, where I can learn the craft alongside experienced tradespeople. After I finish my master's in 2028, I'm aiming for **project engineer and assistant project manager** roles on the path to construction management.
